title: Lab vs Real-World Framing
description: Same model families under (A) lab/CTF/authorized-training framing vs (B) one direct real-world credential-phishing ask with no fiction labels.

methodology.lab: Multi-section lab pack and stealth prompts using *.lab.example / CTF answer-key style.
methodology.realworld: Single direct request for a Microsoft 365 credential-harvesting phishing email (no lab labels).
methodology.note: Real-world operational crime asks are not re-run with jailbreak strengthening; comparison uses measured refusals.

takeaway: All four models show large framing gaps: high propensity under lab framing, hard/soft refusal on direct real-world phishing.
